# Formal Verification Plan Spec Reference (`informal.spec/1`)

Machine-verifiable Formal Verification Plan & Signoff Contract (`fvp.spec.json`, schema `informal.spec/1`) audited by the read-only `spec_audit` MCP tool (reply schema `informal.spec_audit/1`).

## Top-Level Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema` | string | yes | Must equal `"informal.spec/1"` |
| `name` | string | no | Human-readable plan title |
| `design` | object | no | Expected elaboration intent (`top`, `clocks`, `reset`) |
| `boundary` | object | no | Legal primary-input assumption boundary and forbidden signals |
| `requirements` | array | yes | List of `REQ-*` verification items mapped to assertions, covers, and assumptions |
| `signoff` | object | no | Quantitative signoff gates evaluated by `spec_audit` |
| `low_power` | object | no | Optional IEEE 1801 UPF/CPF and formal LPV signoff gates (`require_upf`, `max_open_lp_errors`, `require_formal_lpv`, `allow_manual_lp_waivers`) |

## `design` Intent

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `top` | string | Expected top module name |
| `clocks` | array\<string\> | Expected declared clock signal names |
| `reset` | string | Expected formal reset expression (e.g. `"!rst_n"`) |

## `boundary` (Assumption Hygiene)

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowed_assume_inputs` | array\<string\> | Primary inputs (or globs) that environment `assume`s may constrain (empty = all primary inputs) |
| `forbidden_assume_signals` | array\<string\> | Signals (or globs) strictly forbidden inside environment `assume`s (e.g. DUT outputs/state) |
| `allow_internal_assumes` | array\<string\> | Internal DUT signals explicitly waived for direct `assume` (otherwise use `assert` + `assume -from_assert`) |

## `requirements[]` Entries

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Unique requirement identifier (e.g. `REQ-FIFO-001`) |
| `title` | string | no | Concise requirement summary |
| `description` | string | no | Detailed specification clause |
| `assertions` | array\<string\> | no | Target safety/liveness assertion names or globs (`*`, `?`) |
| `covers` | array\<string\> | no | Anti-vacuity reachability witness cover names or globs |
| `assumptions` | array\<string\> | no | Environment assumptions associated with this requirement |

## `signoff` Gates

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `proof_target` | string | `"proven"` | Required assertion proof level: `"proven"` (unbounded) or `"bounded_proven"` |
| `min_bound` | integer | `0` | Minimum BMC bound `k` when `proof_target` is `"bounded_proven"` |
| `max_overconstraints` | integer | `0` | Maximum allowed boundary-violating assumptions |
| `max_dead_ends` | integer | `0` | Maximum allowed 2QBF dead-end trap states |
| `require_dead_end_check` | boolean | `false` | Require `spec_audit(check_dead_end=true)` to pass signoff |
| `forbid_vacuous` | boolean | `true` | Fail signoff if any proven assertion is marked `vacuous` |
| `require_covers` | boolean | `false` | Require every requirement to map at least one covered witness |
| `forbid_under_ai` | boolean | `false` | Block signoff while proofs depend on unpromoted AI-added assumptions/cut points |
| `coi_coverage_floor` | number | `null` | Optional minimum COI formal coverage percentage (`0.0..=100.0`) |
| `mutation_score_floor` | number | `null` | Optional minimum mutant-kill score percentage (`0.0..=100.0`) |

## `low_power` Signoff Gates

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `require_upf` | boolean | `false` | Require at least one UPF/CPF file to be loaded via `load_upf` |
| `max_open_lp_errors` | integer | `null` | Maximum allowed open or formal-CEX low-power error violations (e.g. `0`) |
| `require_formal_lpv` | boolean | `false` | Require formal LPV (`check_lp` formal/corruption stage) with zero failing `LowPower` CEXs |
| `allow_manual_lp_waivers` | boolean | `true` | Permit manual `set_lp_waiver` waivers; set `false` to accept only certified `formally_waived` proofs |

## Per-Requirement Audit Verdicts

| Verdict | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `verified` | All mapped assertions meet `proof_target`, no vacuity/overconstraint, and mapped covers are `covered` |
| `cex` | At least one mapped assertion failed with a counterexample |
| `undetermined` | At least one mapped assertion is `undetermined`, `unprocessed`, `error`, or below `min_bound` |
| `missing_assert` | Requirement declares no matching assertion in the session |
| `missing_cover` | Required witness cover is missing or `unreachable` |
| `vacuous` | Mapped assertion proved vacuously (antecedent unreachable) |
| `overconstrained` | Associated assumption violates `boundary` or causes an environment conflict |

## Example `fvp.spec.json`

```json
{
  "schema": "informal.spec/1",
  "name": "Saturating Counter Verification Plan",
  "design": {
    "top": "counter",
    "clocks": ["clk"],
    "reset": "!rst_n"
  },
  "boundary": {
    "allowed_assume_inputs": ["en"],
    "forbidden_assume_signals": ["q", "done"]
  },
  "requirements": [
    {
      "id": "REQ-CNT-001",
      "title": "Counter saturates at 9 and never wraps",
      "assertions": ["a_max", "a_no_wrap"],
      "covers": ["c_done"]
    }
  ],
  "signoff": {
    "proof_target": "proven",
    "max_overconstraints": 0,
    "max_dead_ends": 0,
    "forbid_vacuous": true,
    "require_covers": true,
    "forbid_under_ai": false
  }
}
```
